postconditions.expression: output[i] in {-1, 0, 1, 2} for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: Each output value is one of the four specified values.
The answer for vertex 1 is always 1.
The answer for vertex 2 is always 0.
The answer for vertex 5 is always -1.
The answer for vertex 6 is always -1.

invariants.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The number of vertices in each graph is between 1 and 4*10^5.
The number of edges in each graph is between 0 and 4*10^5.
The vertices in each edge are numbered from 1 to n.

invariants.expression: a_i != a_j or b_i != b_j for i != j
invariants.description: There are no multi-edges in the graph.
There are no loops in the graph.
